title: Hwid
description: A hardware snapshot, as serialized by HardwareIds.NET (System.Text.Json with the default options, or Hwid.ToJson) and printed by HardwareIds.Cpp (HardwareIds_GetSnapshotJson, HardwareIdsSnapshot). The schema is strict and versioned with the library: library_version names the version, and so the schema, of the snapshot.

wifis.description: Wi-Fi access points around the computer (only with the Wi-Fi scan).

network_signatures.description: Networks this computer has connected to.

library_version.description: Version of the library that produced the snapshot ("2.4.0", "2.5.0-beta.1"). Each version publishes its own schema: validate the snapshot with the one attached to that release.

id.description: Device number of the disk (PhysicalDriveN), or its index when unknown.

interface.description: Bus the disk is attached to, as WMI names it (IDE, SCSI, USB, 1394, ...).

model.description: Model, or the vendor and product identifiers when the disk has no friendly name.

serial_number.description: Serial number from the storage device descriptor (the value WMI reports).

capacity.description: Capacity, in whole gigabytes (for example "476 GB").

is_smart.description: Whether the disk supports SMART failure prediction.

world_wide_name.description: World Wide Name (NAA or EUI-64), in upper-case hexadecimal.

disk_guid.description: GPT disk GUID, or the MBR disk signature as "0x" followed by 8 hexadecimal digits.

nvme_serial.description: Serial number from NVMe Identify Controller.

nvme_eui64.description: IEEE EUI-64 of the first NVMe namespace.

nvme_nguid.description: NGUID of the first NVMe namespace.

nvme_fguid.description: FRU globally unique identifier of the NVMe controller.

ata_serial.description: Serial number from ATA IDENTIFY DEVICE.

ata_wwn.description: World Wide Name from ATA IDENTIFY DEVICE.

vpd_t10.description: T10 vendor identifier of the SCSI device identification page.

vpd_eui64.description: EUI-64 identifier of the SCSI device identification page.

vpd_nguid.description: 16-byte EUI (NGUID) identifier of the SCSI device identification page.

vpd_naa.description: NAA identifier of the SCSI device identification page.

vpd_scsi_name.description: SCSI name string of the SCSI device identification page.

vpd_vendor.description: Vendor-specific identifier of the SCSI device identification page.

duid.description: SHA-256 of the unique identifier (DUID) Windows computes for the disk, in lower-case hexadecimal.

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

letter.description: Drive letter with its colon (for example "C:"), or null when the volume has none.

networkAddress.title: HwNetworkAddress
networkAddress.description: MAC addresses of a network adapter.

current.description: Current MAC address, as upper-case hexadecimal pairs separated by colons.

permanent.description: Permanent (burned-in) MAC address, as upper-case hexadecimal pairs separated by colons.

id.description: Index of the adapter in the network adapter class (its registry key name, as in WMI's DeviceID).
Index of the entry in its list.

address.description: Bluetooth address, as upper-case hexadecimal pairs separated by colons.

manufacturer.description: Bluetooth SIG company identifier of the manufacturer.

lmp_subversion.description: LMP subversion of the radio firmware.

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

part_number.description: Part number (SMBIOS has no such field, so it is null).

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

UUID.description: System UUID, in lower-case hexadecimal (all zeros when unknown).

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

type.description: SMBIOS chassis type (3 = Desktop, 9 = Laptop, 10 = Notebook, ...).

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

serial_number.description: System serial number (SMBIOS type 1), which is what WMI reports for the BIOS.

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the raw table, in lower-case hexadecimal.

length.description: Size of the table, in bytes.

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

model.description: Brand string (AMD pads it with spaces to 48 characters).

model_number.description: Processor ID, as 16 upper-case hexadecimal digits.

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

capacity_in_gb.description: Capacity, in whole gigabytes (for example "16 GB").

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

unique_id.description: Unique identifier reported by the battery.

monitor.title: HwMonitor
monitor.description: A monitor, read from its EDID.

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

serial_number.description: Serial number (the descriptor string, or the numeric serial).

edid_hash.description: SHA-256 of the EDID base block, in lower-case hexadecimal.

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

width.description: Horizontal resolution of the active display mode (0 when no display is attached to the session).

height.description: Vertical resolution of the active display mode (0 when no display is attached to the session).

refresh_rate.description: Refresh rate of the active display mode, in Hz (0 when no display is attached to the session).

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.
Index of the entry in its list.

domain.description: Domain (the computer name for local accounts).

install_date.description: Install date (Windows does not record one, so it is the default value).

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

machine_guid.description: Machine GUID generated by Windows at installation.

wifi.title: HwWifi
wifi.description: A Wi-Fi access point seen during the scan. The measurements keep their historical PascalCase names.

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

bssid.description: BSSID, as upper-case hexadecimal pairs separated by colons.

Band.description: Band, in GHz (2.4, 5 or 6; 0 when unknown).

networkDevice.title: HwNetworkDevice
networkDevice.description: A device on the local network.

mac_address.description: MAC address, as upper-case hexadecimal pairs separated by colons.

router.title: HwRouter
router.description: The network reached through one interface.

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

network_devices.description: Devices found on the local network (only with the local network scan).

networkSignature.title: HwNetworkSignature
networkSignature.description: A network this computer has connected to.

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

gateway_address.description: MAC address of the default gateway (an empty string when unknown).

selection.description: Selected PCR bitmap, in upper-case hexadecimal.

source.description: Where the certificate was read from.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the DER certificate, in lower-case hexadecimal.

name.description: Provider property or persisted key name.

tpm_usage.description: PCP_KEY_USAGE_POLICY flags (8 denotes an identity key).

public_key_blob.description: BCRYPT public key blob, encoded as Base64.

public_key_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the public key blob, in lower-case hexadecimal.

code.description: Raw error code in its domain.

tpm.title: HwTpm
tpm.description: A trusted platform module. Values the TPM does not support or that are restricted stay null.

id.description: Index of the entry in its list.

lockout_recovery.description: Lockout authorization recovery interval, in seconds.

properties.description: Raw fixed and variable TPM 2.0 properties.
